section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1968
title: mir. With a view to studying the pattern of suicides with respect to population, the volume of suicidal deaths per one lakh of population was estimated and the highest volume of suicided was noticed in Tamil Nadu (14·71), followed by Kerala (14·38) and West Bengal (13·49), as against an average of 7·77 for the whole country. The volume of suicides in big cities is comparatively less than the all-India average. Hyderabad city recorded as high a volume as 15·4 against 5·1 of all the cities studied together.
